_note: RoboForex Prime all-in round-trip cost (raw spread + commission + slippage) in price units, built 2026-11-01 from RoboForex's PUBLISHED figures (https://roboforex.com/trade-conditions/specifications/ and the Prime account page), NOT measured: RoboForex has no public tick archive. Spread = the published Prime AVERAGE spread. Commission = '10 / mio' read as 10 USD per 1 million USD notional PER SIDE (the conservative reading; reviews quote about 1 USD per lot per side, which matches), converted at a conservative price (EURUSD 1.25, USDJPY 125; 2011-25 averages 1.17 and 114). Slippage allowance 0.2 pip, the same as the Exness Zero profile. Swaps: the specifications page lists Prime as NOT swap-free; the March 2026 swap-free programme covers new accounts on currencies and metals and its exact terms are unverified. Intraday strategies that never hold through the 22:00 UTC rollover pay no swap either way.
